sections.Profile:
Polo and Mini Cycle are pinball machines manufactured by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1970. Both games share the same playfield design, with Polo being the four-player version and Mini Cycle the two-player variant. Designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Art Stenholm, these machines feature two flippers, three pop bumpers, a vari-target, a kick-out hole, and a free ball return lane.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1970
